finalDirection: From Hoodsport on US-101, drive about 16 miles on the paved and gravel road to the Staircase developed area.

finalDirection: From Cougar, drive east on Lewis River Road, which becomes Forest Road 90, to the junction with Forest Road 83; turn left and go about 6 miles to the Marble Mountain Sno-Park. Forest Road 83 is gated at the sno-park in winter and early spring.

finalDirection: From Winthrop, head north on East Chewuch River Road for 6.5 miles and turn right onto FR-37. Follow FR-37 for 13 miles, then turn left onto FR-39 and continue 7.5 miles to Tiffany Springs Campground.
